_description: Golden evaluation dataset for RAG pipeline quality testing. Each entry is a manually verified QA pair that the system should answer correctly from uploaded documents.
_instructions: Add your own QA pairs based on documents your users upload. Each entry needs: question, expected_answer (what the correct answer should contain), relevant_doc (which document has the answer), relevant_page (which page), and difficulty (easy/medium/hard).
